title: Aureline M5 template-health-row component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the template-health-row family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A template health row names which health facet it reports and how current the signal is so a row never presents a stale or never-checked health signal as fresh and always names what it is asserting. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
